hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Oceania, consists of 29 atolls and five isolated islands in the North Pacific Ocean, about halfway between Hawaii and Australia; the atolls and islands are situated in two, almost-parallel island chains - the Ratak (Sunrise) group and the Ralik (Sunset) group; the total number of islands and islets is about 1,225; 22 of the atolls and four of the islands are uninhabited || low coral limestone and sand islands || Kwajalein atoll surrounds the world's largest lagoon; the island city of Ebeye is the second largest settlement in the Marshall Islands, after the capital of Majuro, and one of the most densely populated locations in the Pacific || Resources: coconut products, marine products, deep seabed minerals || Exports: ships, refined petroleum, fish, natural gas, stone processing machines (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: low coral limestone and sand islands || Oceania, consists of 29 atolls and five isolated islands in the North Pacific Ocean, about halfway between Hawaii and Australia; the atolls and islands are situated in two, almost-parallel island chains - the Ratak (Sunrise) group and the Ralik (Sunset) group; the total number of islands and islets is about 1,225; 22 of the atolls and four of the islands are uninhabited

climate.excerpt: tropical; hot and humid; wet season May to November; islands border typhoon belt || infrequent typhoons

economy.excerpt: upper middle-income Pacific island economy; US aid reliance; large public sector; coconut oil production as diesel fuel substitute; growing offshore banking locale; fishing rights seller; import-dependent || Exports: ships, refined petroleum, fish, natural gas, stone processing machines (2023) || Industries: copra, tuna processing, tourism, craft items (from seashells, wood, and pearls)
